svg.aria-label: The decision map: mean of the three quality axes against footprint, with the 15 GiB budget drawn as a wall and a 0.78 competitive line drawn across. The three rings are the shortlist, and they are deliberately not the three highest dots — the budget pick sits below the line because it costs 5.4 GiB. Both lines are stated thresholds, not statistics: at 0.79 only two models clear the bar, at 0.75 seven do. There is no median crosshair and no upper-right "leader" corner, because here smaller footprint and higher score are both good, which a quadrant cannot express
svg.title: The decision map: mean of the three quality axes against footprint, with the 15 GiB budget drawn as a wall and a 0.78 competitive line drawn across. The three rings are the shortlist, and they are deliberately not the three highest dots — the budget pick sits below the line because it costs 5.4 GiB. Both lines are stated thresholds, not statistics: at 0.79 only two models clear the bar, at 0.75 seven do. There is no median crosshair and no upper-right "leader" corner, because here smaller footprint and higher score are both good, which a quadrant cannot express
svg.desc: The decision map: mean of the three quality axes against footprint, with the 15 GiB budget drawn as a wall and a 0.78 competitive line drawn across. The three rings are the shortlist, and they are deliberately not the three highest dots — the budget pick sits below the line because it costs 5.4 GiB. Both lines are stated thresholds, not statistics: at 0.79 only two models clear the bar, at 0.75 seven do. There is no median crosshair and no upper-right "leader" corner, because here smaller footprint and higher score are both good, which a quadrant cannot express — computed from the run archive, not drawn by hand.
